interface.signature: words: List[str], letters: List[str], score: List[int] -> int

preconditions.description: The length of the words list must be between 1 and 14.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(word) <= 15 for word in words)
preconditions.description: Each word in the words list must have a length between 1 and 15.
The length of the letters list must be between 1 and 100.
The score list must contain exactly 26 elements.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= s <= 10 for s in score)
preconditions.description: Each score in the score list must be between 0 and 10.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in letters)
preconditions.description: All characters in the letters list must be lowercase English letters.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for word in words for c in word)
preconditions.description: All characters in the words must be lowercase English letters.

postconditions.description: The output must be the maximum score of any valid set of words formed by using the given letters.
The output score must be non-negative.
